caption: 1" MNIST" Fig. 4. The tangent vectors to the high-density manifold as estimated by a Contractive Auto-Encoder (Rifai et al. , 2011a). The original input is shown on the top left. Each tangent vector (images on right side of first row) corresponds to a plausible additive deformation of the original input, as illustrated on the second row, where a bit of the 3rd singular vector is added to the original, to form a translated and deformed image. Unlike in PCA, the tangent vectors are different for different inputs, because the estimated manifold is highly non-linear. .
